body:
I have recently had some really hard times. At the bottom of the pit I fired up some changa for the first time. I smoked and inhaled, held it in, repeated a few times and suddenly the flowers on my table turned into an image of crisp freshness with a glow. I closed my eyes and saw an incredible geometric/fractal dance of shapes on a bright red background. In the middle of it all there was a face of an entity. I recieved a message given in a very intensive way: YOU ARE LOVED! RECIEVE AND GIVE LOVE! It was as though it screamed at me, insisting that I got the message.
I did get the message and it transformed the way I think about life, I am no longer afraid to die and I know that love is all that matters.
